office: the Migration and Borders Service (SMF), Av. 12 de Julho, São Tomé
note: The SMF's fee page for the common passport: 1,500 dobras normally, and an urgency fee of 250 for 24 hours, added here. The page writes 'STD', the old dobra's code, but the amounts are in new dobras (STN): Téla Nón reported the electronic passport's launch price in February 2018 as '1700 novas dobras, cerca de 70 euros'. Delivery at the airport or port (30% more) and issue out of hours (25% more) aren't modelled; nor are validity and a normal processing time, which the page doesn't give.
